correctness.rationale: Exact positive tilt row constraints imply s(t) and q(t); exact column mass correction gives F. The explicit t* satisfies q0=1-b; F>0 and sup Fprime=L<1 for b>a. All quantifiers and zero-cell conventions are explicit. SymPy algebraic identities, 350 seeded one-step checks, and three long boundary checks were executed from the standalone file.

value.rationale: The minimal reflection-symmetric 2x3 finite martingale bridge is the first nonlinear atomic case with a nontrivial martingale row constraint and convex-order slack. The exactly solvable rate/iteration sensitivity exposes the transition from geometric convergence to sharp reciprocal-time behavior at a natural feasibility boundary, a motivated benchmark for convergence theory. This is not a generic derivative of the general exponential convergence theorem, and no arbitrary numerical slice is chosen.
